session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Big Gap Up Then Broad Sideways Trading Range' (ET+12 hrs, Apr 8/9). 100+ point overnight gap up (inset daily trendline breakout), sell-off to an exhaustive sell climax and bear channel breakout at 6780 (bar 18) with strong buying pressure, then a broad sideways trading range the rest of the day with multiple 2 leg reversal moves, double top failed, truncated wedge top (01:00 high 6828), second leg up bull trap, micro double bottom, late 2nd leg down to support bear trap (03:15 low 6787.5) and rally into the close 6820.50. Inset: Trading Range or Santa Claus Rally?
